results.title: Feedback Widget for SaaS: Collect Actionable Feedback
results.snippet: A feedback widget is a small interface embedded directly into a website or application that lets users submit feedback without leaving the page they're on. It commonly appears as a floating button, tab, panel, or pop-up. When users click it, they can report a problem, suggest an improvement, request a feature, or share their experience. For a marketing website, a website feedback widget might collect opinions about content, navigation, pricing pages, or usability. Inside a SaaS application, the use case is usually more product-focused.
